verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at developers.make.com that indexes Markdown versions of Developer Hub pages, and many API reference pages are served as .md files an agent can read directly (connections, data stores, AI agents, OAuth flows). Make also ships 'Make Skills', Markdown files written to help AI assistants build scenarios and connect to the Make MCP server. Missing for 10: no evidence of llms.txt or Markdown coverage for the help.make.com docs, the api-documentation.md path returns a 'Page Not Found' body, no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths, and no independent or hands-on reports of agents using these docs.
